vocabulary.description: How the browser keeps a logged-in session: what POST /api/login returns, how later requests carry the session (an httpOnly cookie or an Authorization: Bearer token), and GET /api/me.
The helper exported from src/auth/index.js that other server routes call to get the current user: its name, signature, and what it returns or does when nobody is logged in.
POST /api/events/:eventId/registrations: what the request needs, the response body, and the status codes (201, 401, 404, 409) the UI relies on.
